rows.grounds: comparative formation indicating likeness to Gaṇeśa
internal ritual worship to be performed
injunctive or optative sense directing the ritual action

items.question: In what manner must the practitioner conduct inner worship after identifying the self with Gaṇeśa?
premises: The practitioner meditates on the self as like Gaṇeśa.
Meditation precedes the performance of inner worship.
Inner worship is the prescribed ritual action to be carried out.
items.inference: Therefore, after meditating on oneself as Gaṇeśa, the practitioner should perform inner worship.
uncertainties: The precise ritual details of antaryajanaṃ are not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having meditated on oneself as like Gaṇeśa, one should perform the inner worship.
